_doc: Per-card sound identity used by build_sfx_needs.py. 'voice' = what the thing sounds like (materials, mechanisms). 'attack' = melee|ranged for characters. Neo-futuristic myth: Zeus = high-voltage electricity, gold and bronze plating, thunder, jet wind; Poseidon = deep water pressure, sonar, hydraulics, coral and shell, abyssal resonance.
